title: German Braised Bao with Cabbage and Hydro-Cooked Hearty Meat
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked bao, tender cabbage, and hydro-cooked meat.
instructions: Heat the hydro vegetable broth to 180°F (82°C) in a large pot.
Add the hearty meat to the broth and cook for 30 minutes, or until browned.
Add the shredded cabbage to the pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the bao according to package instructions and set aside.
Add the German beer to the pot and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the blue cheese (if using) and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the braised cabbage and meat mixture over the cooked bao.
Garnish with additional blue cheese and parsley (if desired).
